name: September 11 2001
overview: The events of September 11, 2001, remind believers of the reality of affliction and the sovereign protection of God. Scripture assures that those who dwell in the secret place of the Most High will abide under His shadow and be preserved from all evil, even amid great trials and calamities. The prophetic burdens and visions in Isaiah reveal that times of judgment and upheaval are under God’s sovereign control, yet His blessing remains upon His people and all families of the earth through His covenant promises. These truths call Christians to trust in God's protection and sovereign plan despite the darkness of difficult days.
